featured_reviews.name: Ninad Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall, the experience was average. The ambience was decent and the décor was well done, creating a pleasant visual setting. However, beyond the interiors, the overall experience did not quite meet expectations.

The service was noticeably slow, even though most of the tables were unoccupied at the time. The pasta took nearly 45 minutes to be served, which significantly affected our dining experience. By the time the food arrived, we had almost lost interest.

As for the food itself, it was neither bad nor exceptional. It was simply average and did not justify the price point. Given the cost, one would expect better quality and more attentive service.

A service charge was added to the bill, which I requested to be removed as the service did not feel up to the mark. While the place has potential in terms of ambience, improvements in service efficiency and overall value for money would greatly enhance the experience.

Mix sauce pasta -

featured_reviews.name: The explorer
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had visited starbucks a few times at r city and latest visit was during their 50% offer on 17,18 Jan via dineout. As expected,the outlet was crowdy but the staff were very prompt in taking orders, serving and cleanup of the tables. This enabled freeing up of the tables quicker and a less waiting time overall. Hence appreciation to the staff for still ensuring a smooth ordering and dining experience.
Coming to our last order, we opted for their veg sandwiches namely a paneer sandwich (without bread) with a red beetroot filling?, broccoli and mushroom pesto sandwich, java chip frappuccino and hazelnut flat white. The sandwiches were underwhelming to me. Paneer sandwich had paneer slices in place of bread and the paneer was in itself a bit dry. The filling was not so flavorful and the overall bite into this sandwich wasn't yielding any flavor or texture. The broccoli sandwich had a nice filling but the extremely rusky and biscuit-like focaccia has made this sandwich rather uncomfortable to eat. We had never seen focaccia that is crusty,hard and had a hard time biting/cutting the crust. Disappointed with the previous sandwiches, we decided to order our usual spinach corn sandwich that we love at this place. But the bread is so soggy and the filling lacked flavor this time. Probably the sandwiches are prior prepped to meet the high demand and they turned out either crusty/soggy. The outlet otherwise serves great sandwiches.

Moving to the beverages, hazelnut flat white was a nice change to our usual orders. Hazelnut flavor was apt with a mild coffee shot. Java chip frappuccino was watery and was overloaded with foam,whipped cream and chocolate sauces unlike the usual preparation.

Overall, it is suggested to visit starbucks when the crowd is lesser for a better experience and good food/beverage.
